description:
Seen by the fz-kdt.143 cold review (2026-09-02, main a3a9761d1):
matrix::polymorphic::build failed once with
  "fz2-built binary exceeded 3s; stderr:"
during a full `cargo test --test fixture_matrix -- --test-threads=1` run that
shared the machine with a parallel corpus dump (xargs -P 6); it passes in
isolation and in a clean full run (485/0/9). tests/fixture_matrix.rs:75
FIXTURE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT = 3s is measured from execution-ready (or spawn) on
wall clock, so any machine contention converts a correct fixture into a red
gate. Same class as the tripwire fz-f98.23 retired ("always red on CI").
Direction: a budget that measures the fixture's own work (its telemetry
counters / reductions, which the matrix already reads for other assertions)
or a generous hang guard (tens of seconds) that only catches genuine
non-termination -- not a 3s wall clock. Not observed to move any answer.
title: fixture_matrix's FIXTURE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT (3s wall clock) is a contention tripwire: polymorphic::build flaked under a parallel corpus sweep
